subject: Post-call: Monthly spend verification & PO onramp
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Nora Patel <nora@helioapps.com>, Samir Dutta <samir@helioapps.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Monthly spend verification & PO onramp

Thanks again for the time today, Nora and Samir — good conversation. Quick recap + two asks so we can align next steps with your procurement timeline.

Recap
- Primary use case: customer support summarization + routing + short-form generation for automated replies.
- Expected active users: 4k–6k end-users in the next 6 months; peak concurrency unknown (we flagged for load test).
- Latency target: 200–400ms p95 for sync generation; streaming acceptable for non-blocking flows.

Pricing/volume signals from the call (please confirm):
- Target monthly spend band: $8k–$18k (this was the ballpark Nora mentioned during budget planning).
- Procurement threshold: PO required above $10k/month; anything above $15k/month will need executive sign-off and an updated SOW.
- Target unit economics you asked about: target $/1M tokens around $275–$320 (team trying to match internal benchmarks).

Asks
1) Can you confirm the correct monthly spend band we should size for (pick one): <$10k, $10k–$15k, or >$15k?
2) Who is the procurement contact and typical PO lead time once budget is confirmed? (we'd like to align our onboarding window).

Attached: Redwood_pricing_options_v2.pdf (3-tier commit scenarios + short token examples) and a lightweight MAAP requirements checklist we discussed.

Next steps we propose if the band is <$10k: 2-week pilot on hosted API (self-serve) to validate token velocity and latency; if 10k–15k, recommend a small reserved pool (Dedicated lite) + 30-day ramp; if >15k, we can fast-track an enterprise PO and a one-off onboarding SLA.

I'll pause here until you confirm the band and procurement contact. Thanks — Rafael

--
Rafael Mendes

rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
From: Nora Patel <nora@helioapps.com>

Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:10:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Monthly spend verification & PO onramp

Thanks, Rafael — helpful summary. Confirming the items from our side: 

- Monthly spend band: we are planning for the 10k–15k band for Q4 as an initial commit bracket. This reflects conservative adoption estimates from product and finance.
- Procurement threshold: correct — PO is required for recurring spend; approvals needed above $15k require finance director sign-off.
- Target unit economics: our internal goal is closer to $300/1M tokens but we have wiggle room if latency and support tradeoffs justify it.

Procurement contact: Priya Natarajan (procurement@helioapps.com) handles PO intake, and typical lead time is 10–14 business days once budget is approved. If we need an expedited route, Samir will escalate.

Samir and I reviewed the Redwood_pricing_options_v2.pdf and have two quick clarifying questions for your pricing team:
1) For the Dedicated lite scenario, is there a minimum commit length? (we prefer month-by-month but can consider quarterly).
2) Does the $/1M token estimate include KV cache savings assumptions or is that list price?

I'll coordinate internally and loop Priya once we finalize the band.

Best,
Nora

--
Nora Patel
CTO | HelioApps
nora@helioapps.com | +1 (628) 555-2299
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Nora Patel <nora@helioapps.com>, Samir Dutta <samir@helioapps.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 10:05:48 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Monthly spend verification & PO onramp

Nora — quick technical/pricing clarifications from the SE side. Re: your two questions: 

1) Dedicated lite minimum commit: we can do month-to-month for the lite pool with a 30-day notice to change sizing. Quarterly commits are available for a modest discount.

2) The $/1M token figures in the PDF are conservative list estimates and do NOT bake in optimistic KV cache savings. In practice we often see 10–25% effective token cost reduction for routing-heavy support workloads (prefix caching + conversation KV reuse). If you can share a small prompt set or typical request/response lengths, I can run a quick simulation and give a more concrete effective $/1M.

For quick reference, ballpark effective unit economics by commit tier (examples):
- Hosted pay-as-you-go: $420 / 1M tokens (no commit)
- Dedicated lite (monthly): $310 / 1M tokens (assumes modest batching, limited cache)
- Dedicated standard (quarterly commit): $260 / 1M tokens (assumes 15% effective cache)
- Enterprise reserved (annual): $240 / 1M tokens + SLA and extended observability

If Helio can target the 10k–15k band, Dedicated lite will likely be the best mix of predictability and low onboarding friction. Happy to run a 48-hour token-velocity test with a small key if you want a data-driven estimate.

—Ben

--
Ben Carter
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Nora Patel <nora@helioapps.com>, Samir Dutta <samir@helioapps.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <procurement@helioapps.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Monthly spend verification & PO onramp

Appreciate the confirmation, Nora. Quick response and suggested plan to keep momentum: 

1) Band confirmed: 10k–15k monthly. We'll size a Dedicated lite pool as Ben recommended. Ben — please prepare a 30-day month-to-month pricing quote (include the $/1M token line items and a small note about expected cache uplift).

2) Procurement next step: Nora — looping Priya here. Priya, can you confirm the preferred PO template and whether Helio uses DocuSign or a paper PO? Also, typical lead time was called out as 10–14 business days — is that still accurate?

3) Pilot datapoint: Nora/Samir, if you're open to it, we can run a 48-hour token-velocity test on hosted API to produce an empirical $/1M estimate before you commit. This requires a small API key and sample traffic (Ben can set up a scoped key).

Proposed timeline:
- This week: Ben sends the Dedicated lite quote + short note on unit economics.
- Early next week: Helio confirms PO template and target approval date.
- Within 10 business days of PO: onboarding kick-off and access.

If that looks right I'll convert the Dedicated lite option into a one-page quote and share a DocuSign link (or a PO form) for Priya to review.

Thanks — Rafael
